This '''canyon krayt dragon''' lived in the [[Eastern Dune Sea]] in the [[Rakatan Ruins (Tatooine)|Rakatan Ruins]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was killed by [[Komad Fortuna]] and [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] by luring it towards [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]] and exploding it with [[Mine/Legends|mines]]. Revan collected the [[Krayt dragon pearl/Legends|krayt dragon pearl]] from its gullet to prove that he was worthy of hearing the history of the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] and for use in [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Kotor" />
